name: Carolai Anise
summary: In Brill, Carolai Anise teaches alchemy while her experiments make the guards uneasy.

sections.title: A Volatile Craft
sections.body: Carolai Anise pursues alchemy in Brill, where she teaches novice alchemists. Many Forsaken researchers work under the Royal Apothecary Society's grim mandate, but Carolai makes her own strange brews inside the settlement. Her unpredictable experiments and smoking retorts are well known. The Deathguards watching Brill openly grumble that she seems bent on blowing up her own house.

faq.answer: Carolai Anise is an undead alchemy trainer in Brill, in Tirisfal Glades. She teaches aspiring Forsaken to brew potions, elixirs, and oils.
Carolai works with her alchemy supplies inside a building in Brill, the primary Forsaken town in central Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why do the Deathguards complain about her?
faq.answer: The Deathguards complain that Carolai's unstable experiments could cause an accident. They joke or fret that she may eventually blow up her entire house.

angles.text: As a newly liberated Forsaken learning to handle reagents, you can learn the foundations of alchemy from Carolai in Tirisfal Glades.
As a gatherer in Tirisfal, you can bring Carolai peacebloom, silverleaf, and earthroot to refine into potent mixtures.
